# crawl.cheap — The Web Data Engine for AI (Firecrawl v1 & v2 Compatible · Cloudflare Workers)

> Open-source, Cloudflare-native web data platform speaking 100% of the Firecrawl v2 (57 operations) and v1 (23 operations) API contract at 50% of Firecrawl's core monthly plan price.

## Core Endpoints & Discovery
- Production Web & Studio: https://crawl.cheap (Dashboard: https://crawl.cheap/app/)
- Production API Base URL: https://api.crawl.cheap
- Remote MCP Server (30 Tools, Streamable-HTTP): https://mcp.crawl.cheap/v2/mcp
- MCP Server Discovery Card: https://crawl.cheap/.well-known/mcp.json
- OpenAPI 3.1 Specification: https://api.crawl.cheap/openapi.json
- Ecosystems & Plugins Registry (12 Integrations): https://api.crawl.cheap/v2/integrations
- @theme.tools 28-Library Catalog Manifest: https://api.crawl.cheap/v2/catalog

## Engineering Guides
- [Firecrawl-Compatible Edge Scraping: High-Throughput Markdown Extraction for RAG and AI Agents](https://crawl.cheap/blog/edge-web-scraping-for-ai-agents/): OpenAPI contract parity, headless browser rendering pools, anti-bot etiquette, and deterministic HTML-to-Markdown distillation.
- [Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl & Hibernatable Durable Objects: Distributed Web Crawling with WebSocket Watchers](https://crawl.cheap/blog/cloudflare-browser-rendering-crawl-and-durable-objects/): How crawl.cheap orchestrates Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl, Hibernatable WebSocket Durable Objects, Markdown for Agents, and HMAC-SHA256 lifecycle webhooks at half of Firecrawl pricing.
- [OAuth 2.1 PKCE, Better Auth & 30-Tool Remote MCP Servers: Zero-Trust Web Data Pipelines for AI Agents](https://crawl.cheap/blog/oauth-2-1-pkce-and-30-tool-mcp-servers-on-cloudflare-workers/): Complete engineering specification for running RFC 9728 / RFC 8414 OAuth 2.1 with PKCE S256, Google/GitHub/Magic-Link Better Auth, and all 30 Firecrawl MCP tools on Cloudflare Workers.
- [11-Format Document Parsing & Autonomous Browser Co-Pilots: Workers AI toMarkdown(), Vectorize RAG & 7-Rail Telemetry](https://crawl.cheap/blog/multimodal-document-parsing-and-autonomous-browser-copilots/): Engineering deep-dive into converting PDF, Office, ODF, CSV, RTF, and images to Markdown at the edge, driving persistent Puppeteer sessions with plain-English prompts, and tracing every LLM span with a 2,500ms circuit breaker.
